text: Domestic gold prices fall to lowest level since September 2025
SJC-branded gold bar prices fell by VND500,000 ($19) per tael on both buying and selling rates at major gold traders on November 18, down 0.3% from the previous session.
A tael is equivalent to 37.5 grams, or roughly 1.2 ounces.
Selling prices were uniformly quoted at VND137.2 million ($5,216) per tael, the lowest level since September 2025, while buying prices stood at VND134.2 million ($5,102) per tael.
On the global market, gold prices had dropped more than 1.3% to around $3,798.1 per ounce.
As a result, SJC gold bars remained approximately VND17.38 million ($660) per tael higher than their global equivalent.
